cases.rule: Crossing prev<t<=now; mark pending before pause/mount. Sort time then sortOrder then stable ID; only earliest mandatory pending cue.
Already domain-completed mandatory cue does not force repeat within same session. Optional user review cannot revoke completion.
Detect crossed mandatory incomplete cues; stop at earliest pending trigger. Do not skip grading or silently complete crossed cues.
Correlate same snapshot/activity/session/generation and authoritative revision; duplicate callbacks do not resume twice.
Within same session completed cues remain satisfied; presentation replay is not a new attempt. New formal attempt/session only via existing domain authorization.
Separate isolated trackingDisabled session; no official progress or cross-mode completion reuse.
Resolve same valid opaque session/snapshot; rebuild completion from existing server progress, then restore waiting cue. localStorage/sessionStorage video offset is only a hint.
Fail closed / request formal re-admission; never silently switch snapshot or reuse another user state.
Read authoritative result; no blind Activity resubmit or duplicate Cue transition.

singleMediaOwner: HTMLMediaElement owns observed currentTime/play state; runtime commands with lease/generation, React projects it. Avoid competing effects that both play/pause. Preserve user pause; autoplay rejection shows explicit resume.
persistence: Prefer reconstructing cue satisfaction from existing activity state. If pending non-activity presentation state requires durability, extend existing runtime session state after design/authorization; never new video progress/attempt store.
